scripts.title: Bug fix
scripts.features: I do not know what it is, but when I run the service through an index like "game.Players" then it returns a random service, which is why many scripts didn't work, but they worked through GetService, so I decided to fix it with this script and share with you
scripts.script:
local success = pcall(function() return game.Players.LocalPlayer end)
 if not success then
  substitute = hookmetamethod(game, "__index", newcclosure(function(self, prop)
 if self == game and game:FindFirstChild(tostring(prop)) then
return game:GetService(tostring(prop)) end
  return substitute(self, prop)
   end))
 end
